detailedDerivation: If A(x)/x→β=√2−1, then A(N)→∞ and A(A(N))=β A(N)+o(N)=β²N+o(N). Sinceβ²+2β−1=0, E_AA=o(N).
Conversely E_AA=o(N) and lower boundliminfA(N)/N≥1/3 imply A(N)→∞. Setx_N=A(N)/N; division byA(N) gives x_(A(N))=1/x_N−2+o(1).
The compact cluster setC lies in[1/3,1/2], the upper bound following from distinct d(i)≤2i+1. For eachc∈C, subsequence convergence and A(N)→∞ give G(c)=1/c−2∈C.
Thus eachc∈C isH(y)=1/(y+2) for somey∈C, so C⊆H(C). On y≥0, H has Lipschitz constant≤1/4. Diameter(C)≤diameter(C)/4 forces a singleton.
Its unique value satisfiesc=1/c−2, so c=√2−1. This is blocker value-set density only; ordering discrepancyε remains unpaid. No inference to d(n)/n is made.
